Trivial Mental Mutation, Tolerable

You gain the @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.klCJX0mNpXYH5AIx]{Prejudice} Psychology towards a certain group of people. Consult the table below or let the GM decide. Getting this result again will upgrade it to an @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.Q2MCUrG2HppMcvN0]{Animosity} and then to a @UUID[Compendium.wfrp4e-core.items.Item.E98mVLZgE8bX5vQW]{Hatred}. Alternatively you can add another Target for your prejudice.
